content.comment_body: Hello, Is a watch-dog timer function possible for [product_name]? What would happen if the cycle time takes too long? [user_name]

You can find an example watch-dog program in the attachment. You must implement part 2 of the program either in another [product_name] device or with separate relays. Do not put both parts in the same [product_name] device. Only a faulty processor or crystal could cause a very long cycle time; this isn't likely due to the software, in my opinion.
Thank you for the reply. This approach is indeed a smart way to implement a watch-dog timer.

analysis.insight_summary: The main question was whether a watch-dog timer feature is available for [product_name]. The key insight is that it is not natively supported in standard [product_name] software; a custom solution using multiple devices or external relays is required. Hardware issues, not software, are most likely to cause extended cycle times. This results in users needing workarounds instead of a built-in feature, which may cause confusion or lead to unmet needs regarding integrated safety functions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a built-in or easily usable watch-dog timer feature within [product_name], able to initiate protective measures if cycle times exceed safe limits.
